problems: The caption says the cart is 'fed by a copper cord', but no frame shows a cord reaching the cart. In the 25% frame a thin line runs from the pots up past the tree trunk into the distant grass, and it ends well behind the cart, not on its deck or motor. In the 50% and 75% frames the only line is a faint stroke in the far upper right, nowhere near the cart, so the cart looks unconnected.
The caption says the pots are 'out of the picture behind it', but they are in the picture, lined up in the foreground, for the first quarter of the storyboard (rows 1 and 2) and in the 25% frame.

The caption puts this 'on the beach', but from storyboard row 3 on, and in the 50% and 75% frames, the planks lie on green lawn with giant pink flowers, hydrangeas and mushrooms. Only the first row shows a patch of sand.

Nothing visible links the drum motor to the wheels: no belt, chain or axle drive runs from the black drum on the deck to either wheel. The wheel spokes look the same in every storyboard frame, so the frames do not show the wheels turning.

The camera is locked to the cart, so the cart stays in the same spot and pose in all 16 storyboard frames. The only sign of motion is the background sliding past, which looks as if the scenery is moving rather than the cart driving.

The plank road is made of loose slabs at slightly different heights with visible seams and steps (50% frame, right half; storyboard row 3). The wheels roll over these joins without the cart rising, dropping or tilting at all, so it does not look like the wheels touch the planks.
posts.critique: The caption says a cord feeds the cart and the cart drives itself, but the cord never reaches the cart and the motor is not connected to the wheels. All 11 seconds show the same parked-looking cart while the lawn, not the beach, slides past behind it.
